selection: Within each year and stratum, ascending organization_id then numeric patent_id; select first record. For unchanged choose first organization and first numeric-ID selected patent. Missing strata remain missing.
pair: For each changed case choose first numeric-ID opposite-operation patent in the same organization-year, regardless of its outcome.
historical_examples: The latest two coded-core grants in the preceding five complete years, date descending then numeric ID ascending.
judgment: Read candidate title/abstract and at-issue classes plus historical core examples; do not use citations or later patents to justify technical connection. Outcome-stratified selection means this exercise is not blinded validation.
labels: Future outcomes exported separately. No citation signal is not evidence of uselessness; a signal is not adoption or applicability.
